plan.from: Classification of what kind of entity this is. Drives the Rule #12 lifecycle-state audit: only operational_workflow without lifecycle states surfaces as a gap; everything else passes whether stateful or stateless. Values: operational_workflow (has business workflow, needs lifecycle states + gates), operational_record (per-X record without workflow, e.g. notes, files, acknowledgements, log entries), catalog (config / template / taxonomy referenced by other entities; may carry a publishing lifecycle), junction (N:M link, may carry a qualifier and its own lifecycle), computed (derived rollup; lifecycle implicit in source), unclassified (default; surfaces to audit until set).

plan.from: Free-form catalog-curator notes on this data_object. Empty by default per Rule #15; populate only with explicit per-row user approval. Acceptable content when authored: (1) isolated-master justification when this master legitimately has no edges to other masters in its domain (B6 exemption); (2) self-explanatory-name justification when a master is intentionally aliased-free (B11 exemption); (3) any other catalog-quality annotation that does not fit description / minimum_embedded_shape / naming_authority_rationale. The config-shape exemption for masters with no real workflow has moved to data_objects.entity_type (Rule #12); do not record it here. Per-domain notes belong on domain_data_objects.notes, not here.
